description: This file defines the ZoneLoader class, which is responsible for loading zone configurations from a JSON resource file into a Java Map structure.

classes.name: ZoneLoader
classes.description: A utility class that loads zone configuration data from a JSON file and parses it into a Java Map.

methods.name: loadZoneConfigurations
methods.description: Loads zone configurations from a JSON resource file and returns the data as a Map from String to List of ZoneTransient objects.
